description: Precinct Structure Plans - Road Centrelines is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Victorian Planning Authority. PSP Road Centrelines - BETA version. BETA release of the PSP Road Centreline data as represented in PSP documents. Data is not complete for all Gazetted PSPs at this stage - we will endeavor to add further historical PSP data as time permits. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Victorian Planning Authority. Its tags are Land Use, PSP, Planning, Precinct Structure Plan, Road Centrelines. It offers 7 resource(s) in CSV, DATA TOOL, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, KML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
